findings.claim: Q3 2026 Gross Bookings $59.8B, +20% constant currency (fifth straight quarter >20% per search summary); Mobility +17%, Delivery +23%; Q4 guide $63.25–65.25B (+18–22% cc).
Mobility growth ran 1–2 points below management expectations due to elevated fuel prices and tighter driver supply in some international markets (supply-side constraint); trends improved in October.
Uber One passed 50M members, generating about half of Mobility and Delivery Gross Bookings; agreed to acquire Delivery Hero, expected to close 2H 2027.
About 700 fully driverless vehicles expected on Uber by year-end 2026 and over 2,000 in 2027; $239M loss on Aurora stake in Q3.
